model1.description: Baseline Model ("nothing changes"): 2025 federal polling-place votes inside each district, restricted to the parties standing in 2026, counted with federal preferences. No polling: One Nation stays at its federal level.

model2.description: Forecast Model (core-candidate heuristic): the declared 2026 candidates, 2022 primaries swung to the 2026 polling average, One Nation on its 2025 federal booth pattern, preferences fitted to the 2022 distributions.

model2fed.description: Forecast Model (federal baseline): the same model with the 2025 federal polling-place votes in each district as the baseline and preferences fitted to the 2025 federal distributions.
